conceptual_overlap: Both can increase eating desire without physical hunger.
discriminating_feature: Emotional eating is affect-contingent; external reactivity is food-cue/thought-contingent.
likely_item_cross_loading: EE01/EE03 may load with cue items when stress or boredom contexts contain food.
report_confusion_risk: Moderate: both may be reported as triggers.
validation_test_needed: Correlated-factor CFA/ESEM; latent correlation; event-level trigger discrimination; convergent/discriminant comparators
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate as a hypothesis; do not merge without evidence.

conceptual_overlap: Emotion may initiate episodes that later feel hard to stop.
discriminating_feature: Emotional eating concerns antecedent affect; uncontrolled eating concerns subjective control after initiation.
likely_item_cross_loading: EE behavior items with UC01/UC05, especially under stress.
report_confusion_risk: High: report could confuse why eating starts with ability to stop.
validation_test_needed: ESEM; event-level temporal ordering; incremental validity; diagnostic non-equivalence review
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; explicitly distinguish antecedent from control.

conceptual_overlap: Distress and rigid-rule violation can both precede increased eating.
discriminating_feature: Emotional eating is affect-regulation; restrictive rebound requires inflexible rules/deviation appraisal.
likely_item_cross_loading: EE05 with RR04 if rule violation creates distress.
validation_test_needed: Factor correlations; scenario-based cognitive interviews; longitudinal event analysis
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; test whether rebound is mediated by affect.

conceptual_overlap: Both involve distinguishing affective urge from physical hunger.
discriminating_feature: EE is affect-linked action/desire; HS is access to internal signals.
likely_item_cross_loading: HS02 with EE01/EE04.
report_confusion_risk: Moderate: unclear hunger could be described as emotional eating.
validation_test_needed: CFA/ESEM; hunger-discrimination task or diary; discriminant comparator
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate and avoid causal report language.

conceptual_overlap: Confidence may be lower in emotional situations.
discriminating_feature: EE measures behavior/desire; SE measures perceived capability.
likely_item_cross_loading: SE01 with EE01/EE05; inverse wording association expected.
report_confusion_risk: High if low confidence is reported as actual emotional eating.
validation_test_needed: Multitrait-multimethod model; latent correlation; prospective behavior criterion
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; report behavior and confidence distinctly.

conceptual_overlap: Affect can become a recurring cue for automatic eating.
discriminating_feature: EE requires affect trigger; HA requires low deliberation/repeated context.
likely_item_cross_loading: EE03/EE05 with HA01/HA03.
validation_test_needed: Event-level mediation/moderation; ESEM; prospective diary
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; automaticity is mechanism hypothesis only.

conceptual_overlap: Body-related distress can prompt avoidance or eating-related coping.
discriminating_feature: EE outcome is eating; BI outcome is avoidance of body-salient situations.
likely_item_cross_loading: EE02/EE05 with BI04/BI06 via general distress.
report_confusion_risk: Moderate; risk of stigmatizing causal story.
validation_test_needed: Discriminant measures of distress/social anxiety; CFA/ESEM
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; never infer body distress causes eating.

conceptual_overlap: Stress may disrupt plan execution.
discriminating_feature: EE is eating in affective states; IM is action-plan initiation/repetition/resumption.
likely_item_cross_loading: EE01 with IM04 during stressful schedule change.
validation_test_needed: Latent discriminant validity; context-adjusted prospective adherence model
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; treat stress exposure as context.

conceptual_overlap: Cues may initiate eating that becomes hard to stop.
discriminating_feature: EC concerns attention/initiation due to cues; UC concerns control/continuation.
likely_item_cross_loading: EC03 with UC05; EC05 with UC04.
report_confusion_risk: High: cue-triggered eating can be mislabeled loss of control.
validation_test_needed: ESEM; temporal diary; incremental validity of each factor
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate if antecedent-versus-continuation distinction survives.

conceptual_overlap: Restricted foods may become more salient as external cues.
discriminating_feature: EC does not require rules; RR requires rigid rules and deviation response.
likely_item_cross_loading: EC01/EC05 with RR02.
validation_test_needed: Factor model; manipulation/diary evidence; restraint comparator
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; do not assume restriction created cue reactivity.

conceptual_overlap: Both compare external desire with internal hunger/fullness signals.
discriminating_feature: EC is external attentional pull; HS is perception/use of internal cues.
likely_item_cross_loading: EC01 hunger qualifier with HS02; EC06 with HS awareness.
report_confusion_risk: High due to shared hunger wording.
validation_test_needed: Bifactor/ESEM; local-dependence checks; diary validation
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; reduce shared wording if local dependence is high.

conceptual_overlap: Confidence may be lower when food is visible/available.
discriminating_feature: EC measures reactivity/behavior; SE measures confidence.
likely_item_cross_loading: EC03 with SE04 in opposite directions.
report_confusion_risk: High if report treats low confidence as cue response.
validation_test_needed: MTMM; prospective cue-exposure behavior; discriminant validity
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; preserve different response scales.

conceptual_overlap: Recurring external cues can trigger automatic sequences.
discriminating_feature: EC includes attention/desire; HA includes low deliberation and learned sequence.
likely_item_cross_loading: EC03/EC04 with HA01/HA04.
validation_test_needed: ESEM; nested factor alternatives; prospective cue-action timing; incremental prediction
preliminary_recommendation: Key scientific decision; keep separate until factor and criterion evidence.

conceptual_overlap: Both may involve avoidance, but of different stimuli.
discriminating_feature: EC concerns food attention; BI concerns avoiding body-salient activities.
likely_item_cross_loading: Low, except general avoidance response style.
validation_test_needed: CFA discriminant validity; HTMT as descriptive aid; response-style factor
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate.

conceptual_overlap: Cue-rich environments can disrupt plan implementation.
discriminating_feature: EC is reactivity; IM is plan architecture/repeatability.
likely_item_cross_loading: EC03 with IM04/IM06.
validation_test_needed: Context-adjusted prospective adherence; latent discriminant validity
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; context exposure must not inflate IM score.

conceptual_overlap: A rigid-rule deviation may be followed by subjective loss of control.
discriminating_feature: UC can occur without rules; RR requires rule rigidity and rebound appraisal.
likely_item_cross_loading: UC04/UC05 with RR04.
validation_test_needed: ESEM; event-level sequence; alternative higher-order/bifactor models
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate as hypothesized sequence; no automatic merge.

conceptual_overlap: Difficulty noticing/using fullness may accompany difficulty stopping.
discriminating_feature: UC is subjective control; HS is signal perception/use.
likely_item_cross_loading: UC03 with HS04/HS05; UC01 with HS06.
validation_test_needed: Local-dependence review; ESEM; external interoception/behavior criteria
preliminary_recommendation: Rewrite shared satiety wording before testing; keep constructs provisionally separate.

conceptual_overlap: Past control difficulty may lower perceived capability.
discriminating_feature: UC is experienced behavior; SE is confidence about future/situational ability.
likely_item_cross_loading: UC01/UC05 with SE05.
validation_test_needed: MTMM; prospective behavior; temporal separation
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; distinguish experience from expectancy in reports.

conceptual_overlap: Low-awareness initiation may feel uncontrolled.
discriminating_feature: UC focuses difficulty stopping/amount; HA focuses automatic initiation/sequence.
likely_item_cross_loading: UC05 with HA03; UC04 with HA04.
validation_test_needed: ESEM; item-level temporal facets; prospective observation
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate only if initiation-versus-continuation factors are recoverable.

conceptual_overlap: Both can be consequences/correlates of eating-related distress.
discriminating_feature: Behavioral domains differ: eating control versus body-salient avoidance.
likely_item_cross_loading: General shame response style could cross-load UC04 and BI items.
validation_test_needed: Method-factor model; distress/social desirability measures; discriminant validity
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate and avoid shared shame language.

conceptual_overlap: Uncontrolled episodes may interrupt maintenance; poor fallback may affect resumption.
discriminating_feature: UC measures eating control; IM measures plan execution architecture.
likely_item_cross_loading: UC05 with IM04 after disruption.
validation_test_needed: Prospective adherence model controlling schedule/context; CFA/ESEM
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; do not report implementation failure as loss of control.

conceptual_overlap: Rigid rules can override internal signals.
discriminating_feature: RR requires rule rigidity; HS measures signal clarity/use independent of rules.
likely_item_cross_loading: RR02 with HS06.
validation_test_needed: Factor model; diary of rule use and signals; discriminant comparator
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; relationship is an unvalidated hypothesis.

conceptual_overlap: Rigid deviations may reduce confidence in recovery.
discriminating_feature: RR measures rules/rebound; SE measures confidence.
likely_item_cross_loading: RR06 with SE05; RR04 inverse with SE05.
validation_test_needed: ESEM/MTMM; item residuals; prospective lapse-resumption criterion
preliminary_recommendation: Retain conceptual separation but consider removing redundant recovery wording after evidence.

conceptual_overlap: Rigid plans and automatic behavior can conflict.
discriminating_feature: RR is rule appraisal; HA is low deliberation/repetition.
likely_item_cross_loading: RR04 with HA03 during lapse.
validation_test_needed: CFA/ESEM; prospective rule-cue diary
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate.

conceptual_overlap: Body-related discomfort may motivate rigid attempts; both involve shame risk.
discriminating_feature: RR is eating-rule rigidity/rebound; BI is avoidance due to body appearance.
likely_item_cross_loading: RR03/RR05 with BI04 through negative self-evaluation.
validation_test_needed: Discriminant distress/body-image comparators; longitudinal ordering; ESEM
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; do not infer appearance concern causes restraint.

conceptual_overlap: Rigid plans may be hard to implement and collapse after disruption.
discriminating_feature: RR requires inflexible rules/evaluation; IM concerns setup, clarity, fallback, repetition regardless of rigidity.
likely_item_cross_loading: RR01/RR04/RR06 with IM04/IM05.
validation_test_needed: Competing factor models; ESEM; prospective deviation versus logistical disruption criteria
preliminary_recommendation: Key scientific decision; keep separate pending evidence and reduce shared resumption wording.

conceptual_overlap: Confidence may depend on ability to notice internal cues.
discriminating_feature: HS measures perception/use; SE measures confidence across situations.
likely_item_cross_loading: HS02/HS04 with general SE, limited direct wording overlap.
validation_test_needed: MTMM; latent discriminant validity; prospective signal-use task
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate.

conceptual_overlap: Automatic action may begin before internal signals are checked.
discriminating_feature: HS is signal awareness; HA is low deliberation in context.
likely_item_cross_loading: HS02 with HA03/HA06.
validation_test_needed: Event-level timing; ESEM; criterion diary
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; interaction remains hypothesis-only.

conceptual_overlap: Body awareness and appearance avoidance both mention the body but are conceptually distinct.
discriminating_feature: HS concerns internal hunger/fullness; BI concerns appearance-related participation.
likely_item_cross_loading: Low semantic cross-loading if wording remains specific.
validation_test_needed: CFA discriminant validity; cognitive interview terminology test
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate and use distinct public labels.

conceptual_overlap: Unclear signals may complicate meal planning.
discriminating_feature: HS is internal perception; IM is action design and repeatability.
likely_item_cross_loading: HS06 with IM01 if decisions are unclear.
validation_test_needed: Factor model; context-adjusted prospective planning criterion
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; revise HS06.

conceptual_overlap: Automatic behavior can weaken intention/confidence-behavior correspondence.
discriminating_feature: SE is perceived capability; HA is low-deliberation process.
likely_item_cross_loading: SE04 with HA01/HA06.
report_confusion_risk: High if confidence is interpreted as actual control.
validation_test_needed: MTMM; prospective moderated intention-behavior model; ESEM
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate and test interaction only after main effects.

conceptual_overlap: Avoidance can reduce mastery opportunities and confidence in visible situations.
discriminating_feature: SE is eating-specific confidence; BI is appearance-related avoidance.
likely_item_cross_loading: SE03 with BI04/BI06.
validation_test_needed: Domain-specific self-efficacy comparator; social-anxiety control; CFA/ESEM
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; ensure SE remains eating-specific.

conceptual_overlap: Confidence and practical ability to execute/resume a plan are closely linked.
discriminating_feature: SE is belief in capability; IM is observed difficulty/plan architecture.
likely_item_cross_loading: SE05/SE06 with IM03/IM05; strongest likely cross-loading.
validation_test_needed: MTMM; prospective behavior; competing factor/higher-order models; temporal separation
preliminary_recommendation: Key scientific decision; retain distinct response formats and test rigorously.

conceptual_overlap: Both can reduce deliberate choice, but in different behavioral domains.
discriminating_feature: HA concerns automatic eating actions; BI concerns appearance-based avoidance.
likely_item_cross_loading: Low except general response style.
validation_test_needed: CFA discriminant validity; response-style sensitivity
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate.

conceptual_overlap: Stable cues and repetition are central to both habit and maintenance.
discriminating_feature: HA measures automaticity of existing eating action; IM measures difficulty implementing intended actions.
likely_item_cross_loading: HA02/HA06 with IM05/IM06.
validation_test_needed: ESEM; behavior-specific anchors; prospective habit/adherence criteria
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate by clearly naming target behavior and direction.

conceptual_overlap: Avoidance may look like failure to implement movement/social plans.
discriminating_feature: BI requires appearance-related reason; IM concerns plan mechanics independent of appearance.
likely_item_cross_loading: BI04/BI05 with IM04/IM06.
report_confusion_risk: High when plans involve visible activity.
validation_test_needed: Context and social-anxiety controls; ESEM; domain-specific prospective outcomes
preliminary_recommendation: Keep separate; exclude movement/access context from BI item wording.
